messages:
Raj Patil: Quick sync — ACME SI + Nimbus GPU marketplace listing + joint announce timeline. Need clarity on lead flow post-demo, marketplace referral tagging, and who owns follow-ups in 1P vs channel accounts.
Emma Ross: high level — launch target: week of May 12. Marketplace listing goes live 48h before the press note. Partners want lead credits if they did the demo or intro.
Theo Kwon: FYI our quota ops will freak if we give away credit too broadly. Need a firm claiming window and a CRM tag convention.
Maria Gonzalez: Suggestion: partner gets primary ownership for accounts they sourced OR did the demo within 72h of lead creation. After that window, ownership reverts to Redwood for direct pipeline. Thoughts?
Jason Wells (ACME SI): That sounds reasonable. ACME will only be able to claim if we register the lead in the partner portal + add proof of demo (recording or meeting invite). We can automate via marketplace webhook.
Ally (SE): Technical ask — can partner-demo records push into SFDC as `Lead.Source = marketplace_acme` and `PartnerClaimed=true`? If so we can audit easily.
Raj Patil: Yes, we can require two things to be eligible: 1) partner portal registration with lead id, 2) demo artifact uploaded within 72h. If both present, route to `partner-owned` queue and set tags.
Emma Ross: Decision needed on territory overlaps: NW/US and EMEA sometimes both engage same account. Propose rule: if account has existing Redwood rep (contact > 90 days), Redwood retains ownership; else first valid claim wins.
Theo Kwon: +1. Also add a hard escalation path: if both parties claim within window, ops does a 48h arbitration with evidence (demo recording, signed NDA, intro email). If unresolved, revenue split 60/40 in favor of the party with stronger evidence.
Maria Gonzalez: For marketplace leads (click-to-contact) — default is Redwood-owned unless partner picks up the demo within 48h and registers the lead. Marketplace contact form should include `intended_partner` field.
Jason Wells (ACME SI): We can instrument the marketplace to include that field and fire a webhook to partner portal. We'll also include `partner_demo: true/false` in the payload.
Ally (SE): Small implementation note for infra: webhook payload example:
```
{
  "lead_id": "mp-12345",
  "account_domain": "acme-inc.com",
  "intended_partner": "acme-si",
  "partner_demo": "true",
  "timestamp": "2026-05-10T14:23:00Z"
}
```
Make sure we validate signature header.
Raj Patil: Ops mapping (high level):
```
if partner_demo && portal_registered && demo_uploaded_within_72h -> route = partner-owned
else if marketplace_click && !partner_claim -> route = redwood-owned
else if both_claim -> escalate to partnership-ops
```
Emma Ross: Communication plan: publish a short runbook in Confluence and add a note to the marketplace listing: "Partner-led demos must be registered within 72 hours to claim pipeline credit." Link: https://confluence.redwood/partnerships/si-marketplace-orbit
Theo Kwon: Sales playbook update needed: how to credit for co-sell motion, discounting authority, and who issues quotes. TL;DR — partner can issue non-binding quotes; Redwood issues the final quote if Redwood takes ownership.
Maria Gonzalez: Joint announcement cadence: 48h buffer between listing and public press. For joint webinars, we need an NDA/announce consent from partner marketing 10 days prior.
Jason Wells (ACME SI): Can we get the partner-marketing checklist? I'll confirm timelines on our side. Also confirming ACME will run a joint webinar June 2 if that fits the launch.
Raj Patil: Action items:
- Emma to draft Confluence runbook (due 1765440700). 
- Ally to add webhook signature validation in staging (due 1765443600).
- Theo to update sales playbook snippet and credit rules (due 1765442000).
- Jason to confirm partner marketing checklist + webinar date (reply here).
Emma Ross: I'll put the runbook together and tag legal for the announcement consent flow. Will post a short checklist today.
Jason Wells (ACME SI): Confirmed webinar June 2. I'll upload our marketing checklist to the partner portal and register the webinar. :raised_hands:
partner-bot: webhook delivered to partner-portal (mp-12345) 1765440200 :white_check_mark:
Raj Patil: Thanks all — we'll lock the 72h claim window and the arbitration flow. If nobody objects by EOD, I'll open the PR to ops to enforce tags and routing. :calendar:
Emma Ross: No objections from me. :thumbsup:
Theo Kwon: Approved from sales side.
Maria Gonzalez: Good to go.
Jason Wells (ACME SI): Thanks team! Excited to get this live.
